messages:
Jordan: quick idea — instead of forcing users to make a named role for every one-off route access, what if we add a tiny 'Quick grant' flyout on the route page? gives a scoped grant for a principal with expiry + audit entry.
Ava: I like that. UX concern: we need the audit + ability to convert the quick grant into a persistent role later. otherwise infra teams lose discoverability.
Sam: backend question — do we extend /permissions or add /entitlements/v2? expanding v1 is messy for migration. my leaning: new v2 endpoint that models ephemeral grants + canonical role refs.
Jordan: agreed on v2. minimal surface: POST /api/v2/entitlements/grants {principal, route, actions, expiry, source: "quick-grant"} and a GET /api/v2/entitlements?filter=route for console listing.
Sam: sample we could prototype:
```
POST /api/v2/entitlements/grants
{
  "principal": "service:analytics",
  "route": "projects/:id/model:invoke",
  "actions": ["invoke"],
  "expiry": "2026-04-03T12:00:00Z",
  "source": "console_quick_grant"
}
```
Priya: telemetry & compliance note — every quick grant must emit permission.grant.created with fields (actor, principal, route, expiry, flow=quick). sample rate for telemetry should be 1.0 for audit index but we can sample analytic payloads.
Ava: rollout plan idea: feature-flag behind rbac_compact_grants; canary to 5% tenants + internal org. show 'convert to role' CTA after 24 hrs. fallback: if the v2 endpoint fails, console should show the create-role flow.
Jordan: quota precedence edgecase: route-level reserved capacity quotas vs tenant-level token quotas — granting a principal to a route shouldn't implicitly change quotas. but console should surface a warning: "this principal will be able to call X route but will be limited by tenant quotas."
Sam: also need enforcement semantics: ephemeral grants should be checked at authn layer (authz proxy) with short cache TTL (e.g., 30s) so revokes take effect quickly.
Priya: about telemetry naming conventions: use permission.grant.{created,converted,revoked} and include grant_type quick|role. add permission.grant.converted when user clicks convert CTA.
Ava: small copy: button label = "Grant access (temporary)" and inside note: "You can convert to a reusable role from the grants tab."
Jordan: ok next steps: Sam to sketch minimal v2 schema + validation, Priya to write telemetry contract, Ava to craft microcopy & mock, I'll add frontend flyout prototype and we sync Thu.
console-bot: Feature flag rbac_compact_grants enabled for org:redwood-internal for testing :rocket:
Sam: starting a spike now, will post a draft API contract in #eng-platform when ready. :thumbsup:
